recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It corrects the only current source defect found in the FHIR-45507 application without duplicating approved guidance or changing the Bundle, document, canonical-reference, or Attachment.url semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-45507 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I issue asking to clarify how url-style references participate in Bundle resolution and graph connectedness, including Attachment.url URIs resolvable only within a Bundle, canonical reference matching within Bundles, and message/document graph-connected Bundle guidance.
initial_application: Commit e3fe9fdef25099c995e905af26b84a15734f81c4 applied the requested Bundle notes, Attachment.url wording, and document/messaging links, but also left the literal placeholder text "All message Bundles SHALL be a [fully-interconnected graph](link to above)." in source/messaging.html.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes show proposed wording follow-up on 2024-05-13 and an 8-0-0 Persuasive vote on 2024-06-03. Bundle and Attachment are active normative inputs in source/fhir.ini, and source/hierarchy.xml lists documents.html and messaging.html as top-level specification pages. Zulip searches for the issue key and core concepts found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/messaging.html to remove only the stale placeholder sentence. The actual message Bundle rule still requires a connected graph including the MessageHeader and links to the Bundle Graph-connected Bundles section; the other FHIR-45507 source changes were already present and left unchanged.
